findings.title: Metrics data is encrypted at rest and in transit
findings.rationale: Documentation and Terraform configuration state that the managed metrics database storage is encrypted and that connections from the Metrics API to the database use the cloud platform’s transport encryption, satisfying encryption-at-rest and in-transit requirements for confidential business data.

findings.affected_component: Metrics API and Managed Metrics Database (aws_db_instance.metrics_db)
findings.title: Metrics service and database are not internet-accessible and restricted to internal network
findings.rationale: The system overview specifies that the Metrics Store and Metrics API are only reachable from inside the application subnet and not from the internet, and the Terraform configuration sets the database instance as not publicly accessible. This indicates internal components are not exposed directly to the internet and are reachable only from internal workloads.
